battle.name: 楚漢戰爭
battle.brief: 前206年劉邦先入關中，秦王子嬰降；項羽分封諸侯、楚漢反目，前205年漢軍出漢中定三秦，經井陘、潍水諸戰，至前202年垓下合圍楚軍，項羽自刎烏江。卡面斯巴達長矛屬希臘方陣兵器，與此役相隔約六百年，未曾出現；當時近身用鐵矛戈戟與環首刀劍，遠戰倚賴弓弩，另有車兵與騎兵。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 楚漢戰爭是公元前206年十月至前202年二月、前後約四年的全國性內戰，戰線遍及關中、中原、齊魯、燕趙與江淮。開局並非兩國交兵，而是秦朝中央政府對抗起於民間的六國舊地聯軍：秦以郡縣徵發的戍卒、刑徒與常備兵分屯各郡，巨鹿一線由章邯部將楊熊、董翳等率領，關中則由趙高居中節制，政令由上而下直達地方。與此同時，民間起義在陳勝、吳廣之後湧遍荊楚、齊趙、燕魏韓，前207年楚懷王孫熊心被立為王，同年十月巨鹿破秦後，項羽、劉邦等部眾被推為諸侯上將。義師名號雖舊，兵制仍帶六國遺制：鄉族部曲與諸侯家臣湊成的步兵，楚地善射的弓弩手，北方與關中的車騎混編，既無常備國防軍，也沒有統一後勤。推翻秦朝之後，戰爭重心移入聯軍內部：項羽以霸王身份總制諸侯，分封十八王，徙劉邦為漢王、王漢中巴蜀，關中則分給章邯、司馬欣、董翳。於是楚系（項羽、龍且、季布、鍾離昧、虞子期）、漢系（劉邦、蕭何、張良、韓信、樊噲、周勃、曹參、灌嬰、彭越）以及趙（趙歇、陳餘）、齊（田廣、田榮）、燕（盧綰）、魏（魏豹）諸方，在前205年劉邦還定三秦之後互相爭地：名義上同為項羽所封的諸侯，實則各自割據，隨即倒向楚漢兩家之中。
countriesEn: The Chu-Han Contention was a civil war fought across Guanzhong, the Central Plain, the lands of Qi and Lu, Yan and Zhao, and the Jianghuai region, from the tenth month of 206 BC to the second month of 202 BC, a span of roughly four years. At the outset it was not one state fighting another but the Qin government on one side and the coalition of the old states of Chu, Zhao, Yan, Qi, Wei and Han on the other. Qin levied garrison troops, penal labourers and regular soldiers from the commanderies and counties, with the line at Julu held by the Qin generals Yang Xiong and Dong Yi under the command of Zhang Han, while Zhao Gao directed the government from the centre at Guanzhong and orders passed straight from above down to the localities. At the same time risings among the common people, following Chen Sheng and Wu Guang, spread through Chu, Qi, Zhao, Yan, Wei and Han; the great-grandson of the king of Chu, Xiong Xin, was set up as king in 207 BC, and after the defeat of Qin at Julu in the tenth month of that year Xiang Yu, Liu Bang and the other rebel leaders were raised to the rank of generals of the princes. The slogans were old ones, but the troops still carried the institutions of the pre-imperial states: infantry drawn from village bands and from the retainers of the nobles, archers and crossbowmen from Chu, which was famous for the bow, and mixed chariot-and-horse columns from the north and from Guanzhong. There was no standing national army and no unified logistic system. Once the coalition had destroyed Qin, however, the centre of the war moved inside the coalition itself. Xiang Yu, styling himself Overlord, took charge of the princes, enfeoffed eighteen kings, and shifted Liu Bang to be King of Han with Hanzhong and Bashu as his domain, while Guanzhong was parcelled out to Zhang Han, Sima Xin and Dong Yi. The field was thus divided between the Chu group (Xiang Yu, Long Ju, Ji Bu, Zhongli Mo, Yu Ziqi) and the Han group (Liu Bang, Xiao He, Zhang Liang, Han Xin, Fan Kuai, Zhou Bo, Cao Shen, Guan Ying, Peng Yue), together with the separatists of Zhao (Zhao Xie, Chen Yu), Qi (Tian Guang, Tian Rong), Yan (Lu Guan) and Wei (Wei Bao), all of whom had been enfeoffed by Xiang Yu and who, after Liu Bang recovered the Three Qins in 205 BC, began to fight for their own ground and to lean, one after another, toward one of the two houses.
people: 決定楚漢走向的，是項羽與劉邦兩人截然不同的用人方式。項羽是楚國名將之後，前207年巨鹿破秦時渡河後破釜沉舟、燒廚舍、三日糧，示士卒必死，滅王離軍而遂有霸王之名；他治軍嚴、行軍快、戰意盛，能以少擊眾，卻不居關中而東歸彭城，烹說客韓生，不聽范增之謀，因而失去關中的人、地與糧秣。劉邦出身沛縣亭長，好施舍而結交市井，度量能容人，入關後與父老約法三章、盡除苛法，因而得關中民心；他用蕭何治後方、張良謀全局、韓信將兵，屢次聽勸改變部署，垓下會戰前親率大軍赴前線，最後靠耐心換得合圍。韓信是全役最關鍵的軍事人才：前205年蕭何月下追他於南鄭，說「諸將易得，至如信者，國士無雙」，漢王乃設壇拜大將；還定三秦時行明修棧道、暗度陳倉之計，井陘之戰背水列陣破趙軍二十萬，潍水之戰破楚將龍且二十萬眾，垓下布十面埋伏，漢軍所有戰略主軸皆由他貫通。蕭何留守關中轉輸芻粟，是漢軍能持久作戰的物質前提；張良於鴻門宴護劉邦，又在楚漢相持時籌劃削弱楚方；樊噲闖帳解鴻門之危，灌嬰領騎兵追亡逐北於垓下；彭越以輕騎游擊楚軍糧道，切斷項羽最依賴的補給線；陳平用金買通楚人，離間項羽與范增、鍾離昧之間的信任。楚方有亞父范增屢進良策而不見用，最終疽發背而死；季布藏匿民間，虞子期戰歿於烏江。
peopleEn: What decided the course of the war was the opposite way in which the two men used their subordinates. Xiang Yu was the descendant of a famous general of Chu, and at Julu in 207 BC he crossed the river, broke the cauldrons, burned the cooking pots and gave the men three days' rations to show that no one was to return alive; he destroyed Wang Li's army and took the name of Overlord. He was strict in discipline, fast on the march and eager for battle, and could bring a smaller force to defeat a larger one, but he did not stay in Guanzhong, going east to Pengcheng instead; he cooked the envoy Han Sheng, would not take Fan Zeng's advice, and thereby lost the people, the territory and the grain of Guanzhong. Liu Bang had been a pavilion chief of Pei county, generous and friendly with the market folk, and broad enough in mind to take advice; on entering the pass he made the three-article covenant with the elders and abolished the harsh statutes, which won him the hearts of Guanzhong. He used Xiao He to hold the rear, Zhang Liang to plan the whole picture, and Han Xin to command the army, changed his deployments whenever he was advised to, and went to the front in person with the great army before the battle of Gaixia, winning the encirclement in the end by patience. Han Xin was the most decisive military talent of the whole war. In 205 BC Xiao He chased him under the moon at Nanzheng, saying that the other generals were easily found but that such a man as Han Xin was without a peer among the state's men, and the king of Han accordingly set up an altar and appointed him general. He won the Three Qins by appearing to repair the plank road while the main force came by the old road and through Chencang, broke the two hundred thousand men of Zhao at Jingxing by deploying with his back to the river, destroyed the two hundred thousand of the Chu general Long Ju at the Wei River, and laid the ten-sided ambush at Gaixia, so that every strategic axis of the Han army ran through him. Xiao He, holding Guanzhong and forwarding grain and fodder, was the material precondition for a war of endurance; Zhang Liang shielded Liu Bang at the Hongmen banquet and later planned the weakening of Chu; Fan Kuai broke into the tent to save Liu Bang at Hongmen, and Guan Ying led the cavalry in pursuit after Gaixia; Peng Yue harried the Chu supply line with light horsemen and cut off the food on which Xiang Yu depended most; Chen Ping bought men in Chu with gold and sowed distrust between Xiang Yu and Fan Zeng and Zhongli Mo. On the Chu side Fan Zeng, the old adviser, offered sound counsel again and again and was never listened to, and died of a sore in his back; Ji Bu hid among the people, and Yu Ziqi fell at the Wu River.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是公元前800年前後斯巴達城邦的重裝步兵兵器：兩米長的木槍，前端裝青銅矛頭，槍尾帶銅套以便插地支撐、護住後列；它必須配合圓盾與重甲，密集結陣後方能發揮正面衝撞的殺傷，靠的是方陣裡站得住而非刺得多準。楚漢戰爭比這件兵器晚約六百年，關中與中原的戰場上不可能出現希臘式方陣重裝步兵；而且早在前4世紀馬其頓與亞歷山大東征之後，希臘世界的矛兵也已改用更長的薩里沙與鐵製矛頭，並非卡面所示的早期形制。當時真正上手的是東方體系的兵器：秦漢軍的近身長兵器為鐵矛與戈、戟，戰國楚墓出土的銅矛、戈與鐵劍形制相承，長矛常長逾兩米，湖北江陵望山楚墓出土的吳王夫差矛長近三米，與 dory 的長度相當，槍身同樣是木杆加金屬矛頭，尾端多無希臘式銅套；戈由鉤形援演成直援與內，血脈伸直，可勾、可啄、可割，漢人與楚人皆備之。防身靠皮甲、札甲與各式盾，劍是環首刀形制的直身雙刃劍，漢初仍大量沿用秦劍。遠程火力是此役骨幹：秦弩以銅機弩弦配木臂，睡虎地秦簡與兵俑坑所出弩機可證其已成軍備；弓以楚地射手與韓王信部弓兵為主，羽尾鏃齊備。騎兵是楚漢共有的新銳，漢軍騎兵多來自北方馬匹與降附的趙、燕騎士，灌嬰、周勃、魏越各領一部；車兵承戰國編制，以軿車為載具，漢軍初期曹參、周勃部即以車騎為主。攻城一方備雲梯、穴車、攻城車與撞車，先以弩陣覆壓城頭，步卒扛土囊填壕而進。
kitsEn: The Spartan spear on the card is a heavy infantry weapon of the Spartan city-state of around 800 BC: a wooden shaft two metres long with a bronze head at the front and a bronze butt-spike at the rear, so that it could be planted in the ground for support and to shelter the rank behind; it had to be used together with the round shield and heavy armour, and it was in a tight formation that it killed, not by striking accurately but by standing its ground. The Chu-Han Contention came some six hundred years after this weapon, and a Greek-style phalanx of heavy infantry could not have appeared on the battlefields of Guanzhong and the Central Plain; moreover, since the campaigns of Macedon and Alexander in the fourth century BC the spear troops of the Greek world had already moved to longer sarissas and iron heads, so what the card shows is no longer the shape of the day. What was actually carried on the field belonged to the eastern system: the long close-combat arms of the Qin and Han were iron spears and the ge and ji halberds, the bronze spears, ge and iron swords of the Chu tombs of the Warring States carrying the same tradition in their forms, long spears often exceeding two metres, the spear of the king of Wu, Fuchai, from the Chu tomb at Wangshan in Jiangling measuring close to three metres, comparable in length to the dory, its shaft likewise wood with a metal head and its butt in most cases lacking the Greek spike. The ge had evolved from the hooked blade into a straight blade with a tang, could hook, peck and cut, and both Han and Chu men carried it. Protection came from leather armour, lamellar armour and shields of every kind, and the sword was the straight double-edged blade with a ring-shaped pommel, the Han continuing to use large numbers of Qin swords into the early dynasty. Ranged fire was the backbone of the fighting: the Qin crossbow, with a bronze trigger and bowstring on a wooden stock, is attested as an issue arm by the components recovered from the Qin bamboo texts at Shuihudi and from the terracotta pits. The bow was in the hands of Chu archers and of the bowmen of the king of Han's former kingdom of Han, with fletched and socketed arrows. Cavalry was the new arm shared by both sides, the Han horsemen being drawn from northern horses and from the surrendered riders of Zhao and Yan, with Guan Ying, Zhou Bo and Wei Yue each commanding a division; chariot troops followed the Warring States organisation, the hani war-wagon being their platform, and the early Han divisions of Cao Shen and Zhou Bo were led as chariot-and-horse columns. The side that attacked a city had scaling ladders, tunnel-carts, siege towers and battering rams: the crossbow line first swept the ramparts, and infantry advanced carrying sacks of earth to fill the ditch.
tactics: 楚漢戰爭的戰術沿三條線展開：攻堅、消耗與合圍。巨鹿之戰是教科書式的攻堅：項羽渡河後破釜沉舟，示士卒必死，築壘紮營、塹壕逼近王離大軍，切斷秦軍糧道，在章邯主力來援之前先破其營壘。漢楚拉鋸的主戰場則在關中與中原的據點爭奪：漢軍以蕭何留守關中轉輸糧草，劉邦主力東出，與楚軍爭成皋、敖倉一線，築甬道接連黃河以便漕運；楚軍遠離江淮，糧道冗長，彭越以輕騎游擊糧道反覆斷其糧食，使楚軍在廣武、固陵一線與漢軍相持而糧漸盡。韓信戰法的共同點是避免正面消耗：還定三秦時先佯修褒斜棧道以惑章邯，主力卻從故道、陳倉間道迂迴南下，直取雍地、迫章邯退保廢丘；井陘之戰以背水為奇，趙軍二十萬據井陘口拒漢軍，韓信背水列陣，示弱誘趙軍前出主力，再以輕騎二千銜枚疾馳，換旗易色插入趙軍側後，趙軍大潰，陳餘死於泜水上；潍水之戰則用壅水上流：夜半令人為囊沙塞住上游，待楚軍半渡即擊之，盡壞其水，龍且所領二十萬眾潰散，追至固陵而斬之。垓下是最完整的合圍：韓信將兵三十餘萬，據山嶺分列十面埋伏，前鋒挑戰罵陣激楚軍怒而前衝，漢軍節節退卻引其入彀，兩翼騎兵截斷退路，楚軍遂潰，四面楚歌則瓦解軍心。楚軍的傳統戰術是重步兵結陣正面推進、弓弩齊射作掩護，騎兵與輜重為輔；這與希臘方陣同源，而與漢軍的騎兵突擊、弩陣覆壓構成分野。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Chu-Han Contention ran along three lines: storming, exhaustion and encirclement. The battle of Julu was a textbook storm: after crossing the river Xiang Yu broke his cauldrons and sank his boats, showed his men that no one was to return alive, built his camps and ditches to close on Wang Li's great army, cut the Qin supply road, and shattered the camp before Zhang Han's main body could come up. The main theatre of attrition between Han and Chu was the contest for the strongpoints of Guanzhong and the Central Plain: the Han left Xiao He in Guanzhong to forward grain, Liu Bang's main body moved east, and the two sides fought for the line of Chenggao and Aocang, building a causeway to the Yellow River so that supplies could be carried by water; the Chu army stood far from Jianghuai, its supply road long and exposed, and Peng Yue harried that road with light horse, cutting the food again and again, so that the Chu troops, locked with the Han at Guangwu and Guling, gradually ran out of grain. Han Xin's methods shared one principle, the avoidance of frontal exhaustion. Recovering the Three Qins, he pretended to repair the plank road of the Baoxie gorge to deceive Zhang Han while the main force swung round by the old road and the passes of Chencang, struck into Yong and drove Zhang Han back to defend Feiqiu. At Jingxing he made the strangeness of his back to the river his weapon: Zhao's force of two hundred thousand held the pass of Jingxing against him, and he deployed with the river at his back, pretended to be weak to draw the Zhao main body out, and then sent two thousand light horse with their mouths gagged racing in, changed the flags and colours and thrust into the Zhao rear, after which the Zhao army collapsed utterly and Chen Yu died on the Zhi River. At the Wei River he dammed the stream above: in the night he had men fill the upper course with sacks of sand, and when the Chu troops were half across he struck, ruining the water they were using, and the two hundred thousand of Long Ju broke; he pursued them to Guling and cut them down. Gaixia was the most complete encirclement of all: Han Xin brought more than three hundred thousand men, posted them on the heights in a ten-sided ambush, and sent the vanguard forward to challenge and revile the Chu army until it charged in anger; the Han gave ground by degrees to draw them into the trap, the cavalry on both flanks cut the line of retreat, the Chu army broke, and the songs of Chu drifting in from every side broke what was left of their nerve. The traditional Chu method was heavy infantry pressing forward in formation with a covering fire of bows and crossbows, cavalry and baggage trains in support; that was of a piece with the Greek phalanx, and it was this that divided the field from the Han practice of cavalry shock and crossbow saturation.
data: 可考的數字散見於《史記》。時間上，戰爭自前206年十月劉邦入關中收秦兵、項羽分封諸侯起，至前202年二月劉邦即皇帝位於氈之白水止，前後約四年。兵力上，前207年巨鹿之戰項羽破秦將王離所部，滅秦之後項羽收編秦降卒與諸侯兵，總眾約四十餘萬；前205年韓信拜大將後率兵東出，漢軍主力以關中徵發的秦卒、新附之眾與關東諸侯降兵組成。趙國方面，前204年井陘之戰，趙歇、陳餘集兵二十萬拒韓信，漢軍破之，斬成安君陳餘於泜水上，趙軍十餘萬或殺或降；同年潍水之戰，漢將韓信大破楚將龍且所領二十萬，龍且被斬，成角被斬於固陵。垓下戰前《高祖本紀》記漢兵三十餘萬、楚兵二十餘萬，項羽自稱「身七十餘戰，所當者破，所當者勝，未嘗敗北」，可知楚軍總數略少而精於戰陣。糧食是決定性的一項：楚軍糧道既斷，士卒不能食，項羽乃歌「力拔山兮氣蓋世，時不利兮騅不逝」；漢軍則有蕭何轉輸關中芻粟，作戰數年而糧不絕。收官在跨年之際：前203年十二月至前202年正月，項羽自垓下突圍，至東城僅餘二十八騎，烏江亭長以船相待而辭，遂自刎而死，年三十一。前202年二月，劉邦即皇帝位於氈之白水，定都長安。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are scattered through the Shiji. In time, the war ran from the tenth month of 206 BC, when Liu Bang entered Guanzhong and took over the Qin troops and Xiang Yu enfeoffed the princes, to the second month of 202 BC, when Liu Bang took the imperial title at the White Water of Qian, a matter of roughly four years. In strength, Xiang Yu destroyed the army of the Qin general Wang Li at Julu in 207 BC, and after the fall of Qin he took over the surrendered Qin soldiers and the troops of the princes, gathering a total of rather more than four hundred thousand men; in 205 BC, once Han Xin had been appointed general, he led the army east, the Han main body being composed of the Qin levies of Guanzhong, new recruits and the surrendered troops of the eastern princes. On the Zhao side, in 204 BC Zhao Xie and Chen Yu gathered two hundred thousand men to hold the pass of Jingxing against Han Xin; the Han broke them, cut the chancellor of Cheng'an, Chen Yu, down on the Zhi River, and a hundred thousand odd of the Zhao troops were killed or surrendered. In the same year at the Wei River the Han general Han Xin destroyed the twenty thousand of the Chu general Long Ju and killed Long Ju, while Cheng Jiao was cut down at Guling. Before the battle of Gaixia the Annals of Gaozu record more than three hundred thousand Han troops against rather more than two hundred thousand Chu troops, and Xiang Yu said of himself that in over seventy engagements nothing had stood before him and nothing had beaten him, so the Chu army was smaller in number but better drilled. Food was the decisive factor: with the supply road cut, the Chu soldiers could not eat, and Xiang Yu sang that his strength could pull up the mountains and his spirit cover the world, but the hour was not favourable and his black horse would not go on. The Han, for their part, had Xiao He forwarding grain and fodder from Guanzhong and were fed for the several years the war lasted. The end came across the turn of the year: between the twelfth month of 203 BC and the first month of 202 BC Xiang Yu broke out of Gaixia and reached Dongcheng with only twenty-eight horsemen left; the ferryman of the Wu River offered him a boat and he refused, and he cut his own throat, being thirty-one years old. In the second month of 202 BC Liu Bang took the imperial title at the White Water of Qian and made Chang'an his capital.
cause: 楚漢之戰的起因分三層。最直接的一層是秦的暴政：二世即位後趙高專政，刑罰益苛，郡縣徵發的戍卒、刑徒與勞役不絕，關中之外的楚地田租、徭役與兼并又被地方豪強轉嫁，於是陳勝、吳廣在前209年七月起於蕶澤，旬月之間兵起千里，縣令郡守相望而亡，各路起義以「楚」為號，前207年楚懷王孫熊心被立，各路兵將分別擁立自己的主帥。聯軍雖打出「誅暴秦」的口號，卻沒有統一的指揮與後勤，這就注定秦一旦覆亡，聯軍必然分裂。暴政只是導火線：起義者真正要爭的是土地、徭役與賦稅的支配權，而秦在關中靠郡縣官、徵發制與龐大的刑徒軍隊維持秩序，兩套體系在同一片土地上不可能並存。第二層是秦亡之後權力分配的衝突，這才是決戰的直接原因。前206年劉邦先入關中，按諸侯「先入關中者王之」的約，卻受項羽猜忌；項羽分封十八王，徙劉邦為漢王、王漢中巴蜀，把關中分給章邯、司馬欣、董翳，劉邦到南鄭之後日夜思報而無力反擊。前205年東方諸侯反項羽者已眾，劉邦遂聽韓信計，從漢中出兵還定三秦，殺章邯、司馬欣、董翳，東出伊、洛，戰爭由此全面爆發。追溯到底，項羽的分封固執於功大者王與故楚人當王的封建邏輯，漢一方則以關中郡縣與人口為資源、以追亡逐北的消耗戰取勝，兩套治理技術的競爭，才是這場戰爭真正的分野。
causeEn: The origins of the war lie on three levels. The most immediate is the brutality of Qin: after the second emperor took the throne Zhao Gao monopolised power, the punishments grew harsher, the levies of garrison troops, penal labourers and forced labour from the commanderies never ceased, and in the lands of Chu outside Guanzhong the land tax, the corvée and the concentration of holdings were passed on by the local great families. In the seventh month of 209 BC Chen Sheng and Wu Guang rose at Julu in Chu, within a few tens of days troops rose by the thousand li, commandery and county officers were killed in one place after another, and each rising took the name of Chu for its banner; in 207 BC the great-grandson of the king of Chu, Xiong Xin, was set up as king, and the leaders of the various columns set up their own commanders in turn. The coalition shouted the slogan of destroying the tyrant Qin, but it had no unified command and no unified logistics, which meant that once Qin fell the coalition was bound to split. The brutality was only the tinder: what the rebels truly wanted was control of land, of corvée labour and of the tax revenues, while Qin held Guanzhong together through commandery officials, a system of levies and an enormous army of penal labourers, and the two systems could not coexist on the same ground. The second level is the struggle over how power was to be distributed after the fall of Qin, and this is the direct cause of the decisive war. In 206 BC Liu Bang entered Guanzhong first and, by the princes' agreement that whoever entered the pass first should be king of it, was made suspect by Xiang Yu; Xiang Yu enfeoffed eighteen kings, shifted Liu Bang to be King of Han with Hanzhong and Bashu, and divided Guanzhong among Zhang Han, Sima Xin and Dong Yi, and Liu Bang, once installed at Nanzheng, thought of revenge by day and night but had no strength to strike it. In 205 BC many of the eastern princes were already in revolt against Xiang Yu, and Liu Bang therefore took Han Xin's advice, marched out of Hanzhong, recovered the Three Qins, killed Zhang Han, Sima Xin and Dong Yi, and drove east through Yi and Luo, and the war was fully under way. At the root of it all, Xiang Yu's enfeoffment was bound to the feudal logic that the man of greater merit should be king and that a Chu man should rule Chu, while the Han side used the commanderies and the population of Guanzhong as its resource and fought a war of exhaustion in pursuit of the fleeing enemy. The competition between these two techniques of government was the real division of the war.
impact: 楚漢戰爭結束時，一個新王朝掌握了中原，但它能沿用的制度框架是秦人的。漢承秦制，郡縣、編戶齊民、徭役與軍功爵制在新王朝手裡延續下來，而戰爭本身把六國舊貴族與地方世族打得七零八落，楚地項氏、趙地陳餘、齊地田氏相繼覆滅，軍功勳貴成為新階層，漢初的無為而治與休養生息則與戰後人口銳減、廢墟遍地的現實直接相關，蕭何、曹參先後主持關中、以漕運輸京師物資的做法，正是把戰爭經驗用於國家建設的痕跡。軍事技術層面，戰爭推動了三件大事：其一，騎兵取代車兵成為野戰主力，韓信、灌嬰、魏越各建騎軍，漢廷從此能以輕騎越千里迂迴敵後；其二，弩的兵種化，秦弩成建制部署，漢軍在攻城與野戰都以弩陣覆壓，把弓弩從單兵器械變成合擊火力；其三，戰車編制的式微與步兵裝備的鐵器化、札甲化，使東方軍隊在面對馬其頓式方陣時並不落下風。文化上，楚漢相爭本身成為中國歷史書寫的第一個大敘事原型，而垓下之夜的四面楚歌、霸王別姬與烏江自刎被後世文學一遍遍重寫，成為英雄末路與興亡之歎的母題；對同時代的匈奴而言，漢廷的注意力轉向內戰，正給了北方游牧政權喘息與坐大的空間，這一副作用又在此後百餘年的漢匈戰爭中才被重新補上。
impactEn: When the Chu-Han Contention ended a new dynasty held the central plain, but the institutional frame it was able to keep was the Qin one. The Han took over the Qin system, and the commanderies and counties, the registration of households and their assignment to the soil, the corvée and the system of ranks awarded for military service all carried on under the new dynasty; the war itself had smashed the old aristocracy and the local great families, the Xiang of Chu, the Chen Yu of Zhao and the Tian of Qi being wiped out one after another, and men risen on merit became the new order. The restful government and the policy of recuperation at the beginning of the Han correspond directly to the realities of a population cut by war and of a countryside in ruins, and the practice of Xiao He and Cao Shen in turn taking charge of Guanzhong and carrying the goods of the capital by water is a visible mark of war experience turned into state building. At the level of military technology the war drove three things forward. First, cavalry replaced the chariot as the arm of manoeuvre in the field, Han Xin, Guan Ying and Wei Yue each raising a body of horse, and from then on the Han could carry light forces round the enemy for a thousand li. Second, the crossbow became a branch of service: the Qin crossbow was issued in formed units, and Han troops both in sieges and in the open field used crossbow lines to saturate the ground, turning an individual arm into a combined fire. Third, the decline of the chariot organisation and the iron and lamellar equipping of the infantry meant that the eastern armies were in no way inferior when they met a Macedonian phalanx. In cultural terms the contention of Chu and Han became the first great narrative model of Chinese historical writing, and the songs of Chu on all sides in the night at Gaixia, the parting of the overlord and his consort, and the suicide at the Wu River were rewritten by later literature again and again, becoming the standard theme of the hero at his last stand and of the sigh over rise and fall. To the Xiongnu of the same age, the fact that the attention of the Han court was turned inward on a civil war gave the northern nomadic powers room to breathe and to grow, and it took more than a hundred years of later Han-Xiongnu warfare to repair that side effect.
result: 前202年正月，垓下之戰的結果是楚軍全軍覆沒：韓信十面埋伏合圍，項羽率騎先突，至東城只剩二十八騎，烏江亭長操船相待，項羽歎「天之亡我，非戰之罪」，自刎而死，屍首為漢騎所傳。楚地隨即由漢軍接管，項氏宗族與楚地舊將或降或散，季布匿於濮陽周氏，鍾離昧被逼自盡，虞子期戰歿。漢王劉邦在戰後論功行封：韓信先封齊王、戰後改封楚王，彭越封梁王，英布封九江王，樊噲封舞陽侯，曹參封平陽侯，周勃封絳侯，灌嬰封穎陰侯，陳平封曲逆侯，張良封留侯，蕭何封酂侯，同母弟劉交封信武侯，並追認義帝與趙王等舊號。新王朝在疆域上採郡國並行：關中、潁川、南陽等核心地區置郡縣，東方舊地分封同姓與功臣，兵權、糧秣與法律的形式全部承接秦制。戰爭四年，最終以漢勝楚亡告終；楚歌四面與烏江夕照則成為此後兩千年講述英雄末路時最常被引用的兩個畫面。
resultEn: In the first month of 202 BC the battle of Gaixia ended with the complete destruction of the Chu army: Han Xin's ten-sided ambush closed around them, Xiang Yu broke out at the head of his cavalry and reached Dongcheng with only twenty-eight horsemen, the ferryman of the Wu River stood with his boat, and Xiang Yu sighed that Heaven had destroyed him and that this was not the fault of the battle, and cut his own throat; his body was carried off by Han horsemen. Chu territory passed at once to the Han army, the clan of the Xiang and the old Chu generals either surrendered or scattered, Ji Bu hid at the Zhou house in Puyang, Zhongli Mo was driven to suicide and Yu Ziqi fell in the fighting. The king of Han, Liu Bang, then reckoned up the merits and distributed the fiefs: Han Xin, first king of Qi and after the war king of Chu, Peng Yue as king of Liang, Ying Bu as king of Jiujiang, Fan Kuai as marquis of Wuyang, Cao Shen as marquis of Pingyang, Zhou Bo as marquis of Jiang, Guan Ying as marquis of Yingyin, Chen Ping as marquis of Quyu, Zhang Liang as marquis of Liufu, Xiao He as marquis of Zao, and his half-brother Liu Jiao as marquis of Xinwu, while the old titles of the Yi emperor and the king of Zhao were confirmed in memory. The new dynasty ruled the country by commanderies and kingdoms together: the core regions of Guanzhong, Yingchuan and Nanyang were administered as commanderies, the old eastern lands were enfeoffed to men of the same surname and to meritorious generals, and the forms of military command, of transport and of law all followed the Qin model. The war lasted four years and ended with the Han victorious and Chu destroyed; the songs of Chu on all sides in the night and the sunset at the Wu River have since become the two images most often invoked when the last stand of a hero is told.
